deferred_from_pr_review.title: revokeConsent transaction spans suspension points; other DatabaseManager writers can interleave into the uncommitted transaction
deferred_from_pr_review.location: ConsentStoreActor.swift revokeConsent (BEGIN..COMMIT with multiple await purgeTable/writeAuditLog suspension points)
deferred_from_pr_review.reason: The transaction body awaits DatabaseManager calls, so actor re-entry lets other callers interleave writes on the same SQLite connection inside the uncommitted transaction; a purge rollback would also roll back the interleaved writes (D-005 integrity risk). Fix requires a single actor-isolated purge operation on DatabaseManager (no suspension inside the transaction); large refactor, deferred out of 3F.1 PR scope.
